SUBARU-SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SUBARU-SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Options for the Subaru Natsuki mod. Only basic information is shown for now.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.ABOUT_BODY: Return by Death / Authority / Witch's Scent.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.AUDIO_BGM_REPLACE_DESC: Turn off to play the vanilla battle music.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.AUDIO_REWIND_VOLUME_DESC: 0% mutes it, 100% is the default volume.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.AUDIO_VOCAL_INTRO_DESC: Turn off to start straight from the instrumental part.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.AUDIO_VOCAL_VOLUME_DESC: Only affects the opening vocal section.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.VISUAL_HIT_FX_DESC: Hit stop, screen shake, camera punch, impact bursts, hit flashes, spell volleys (including "damage lands when the volley hits"), the Yae Tenzen screen-cut, and card dimming while waiting. When off, none of these play and cards resolve damage at vanilla timing. (Hit SFX and the kill effect have their own switches.)
SUBARU-SETTINGS.VISUAL_KILL_EFFECT_DESC: On a kill: white flash, player and enemy become purple silhouettes, the enemy cracks and shatters. Same rule as normal enemies: only the blow that clears the last non-minion enemy gets the full version, other kills get the short one. Killing only minions does not trigger it. Disabled in multiplayer.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.VISUAL_KILL_BRIGHTNESS_D: 50%–150%, default 100%. Applies to the white flash, silhouettes, cracks and shards; the seams between shards always stay pure black.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.AUDIO_HIT_SFX_DESC: Turn off to mute hit sounds. Hit-stop, impact flashes and the kill effect are unaffected.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.CUTIN_ENABLED_DESC: Character portraits cut in when you play a card (silhouette + two frames + portrait + veil). On by default. Turning it off disables every cut-in (screen-cuts, strikes and kill effects have their own switches).
SUBARU-SETTINGS.CUTIN_REPEAT_DESC: Off (default): each character appears once per turn. On: the same character may appear several times in a turn.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.CUTIN_MAX_DESC: 0-9, default 3. 0 turns cut-ins off. Once the limit is reached no more cut-ins that turn; a finishing blow ignores the limit.
SUBARU-SETTINGS.CREATOR_MODE_DESC: When on, three test buttons appear at the top-left of Subaru's combats: "Add a card" (pick any card and put it straight into your hand), "Energy +3" and "Max HP +10". It only affects your own combats and is saved with your settings - turn it off for normal play. Takes effect from the next combat.
